corner-rod-with-hooded-head.description: An L-shaped piece of bar border. A thin tan and gold rod with a pink inner band and white dots rises from a lower-left knot and carries at its top a human head in a pale green hood, the face turned to the right. At the foot the rod meets a pink and blue angular knot with a white curl and a gold boss, from which a short horizontal bar of blue, white and gold runs to the right and ends in a gold leaf tip. Black contours; the background is transparent.
corner-rod-with-hooded-head.title: Corner rod with a hooded head at the top
usage_notes: Bottom-left corner of a block; the long arm runs up the left edge and the short arm along the bottom.

dancing-dog.description: A pale grey-green dog rears up on its hind legs facing left, forelegs raised and bent in front of its chest, mouth open and ears back, its long tail curving out to the right and ending in a hooked tip. Heavy black contours with grey-blue shading on a cream-grey body; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Man playing harp and dog dancing

dancing-dog.title: Dog dancing on its hind legs
usage_notes: Dances to the harp of seated-harp-player; placed to the right of the player the two face each other.

left-rod-with-two-profile-heads.description: A tall vertical bar from the left margin. The upper half is a blue band with a row of white rings beside a pink band with a white wavy line; at mid-height a gold disc sits on the left edge where the bar narrows into a thin blue rod with a white zigzag. A bald head in profile faces right at the top, and the rod curves right at the bottom into a second profile head with a white cap band and a red cheek, also facing right. Black contours; the background is transparent.
left-rod-with-two-profile-heads.title: Left-margin rod with two profile heads
usage_notes: Both heads look right, into the page; place it down the left edge of a block.

lower-black-foliate-curl.description: A black ink flourish from the lower margin, a thin line sweeps down from the upper left, curves along the bottom and runs out to the right, carrying a cluster of small solid leaves at its centre and a knobbed terminal at the right end. The ink is grainy and slightly broken, as in the source. Black only; the background is transparent.
lower-black-foliate-curl.title: Black pen-flourish with a leaf cluster
usage_notes: Bottom-margin flourish of the fol. 52r border; reads best under a block, with right-black-leaf-curl-on-blue-and-gold-stem rising at its right.

lower-profile-head-on-long-blue-and-gold.description: A tall vertical bar. For two thirds of its height it is a wide band of gold, pink with a white wavy line, and blue with white edges, cut flat at the top. It then narrows through a blue and pink angular leaf knot with a white lobe into a thin blue rod that curves to the left at the bottom and ends in a human head in profile with a white hood, facing left. Black contours; the background is transparent.
lower-profile-head-on-long-blue-and-gold.quality: Cut flat at the top edge where it left the bar border.
lower-profile-head-on-long-blue-and-gold.title: Long margin rod ending in a hooded profile head
usage_notes: The head hangs below the rod and looks left; use it down the right edge of a block, or flip it for the left.

monkeys-playing-chess.description: Two tan monkeys with hatched fur sit facing each other on either side of an upright gold chequered board painted on a black ground between them. The left monkey holds up a small gold chess piece in one hand; the right monkey rests a hand on the board. Both sit with bent legs and splayed feet, in heavy black contours; the background is transparent.
monkeys-playing-chess.title: Two monkeys playing chess
usage_notes: One scene; the board is held between the two players and both hands overlap it, so do not crop it apart.

monkeys-singing-at-lectern.description: Two cream monkeys with hatched fur stand upright one behind the other at the left, mouths open in song, facing right towards a tall brown lectern. The front monkey stretches an arm to the open book on the slanted desk, whose pages show ruled lines of text; the lectern stands on a tall ochre-brown foot. Black contours; the background is transparent.
monkeys-singing-at-lectern.title: Two monkeys singing at a lectern

orange-trefoil-flower.description: A small orange flower of three rounded lobes, one pointing up and two to the sides, with a short stub of stem below. Each lobe is edged with a painted white outline and carries a white dot or stroke; a thin dark contour surrounds the whole. The background is transparent.
orange-trefoil-flower.quality: Only 283 px wide; the white outline sits on a soft grey-green rim that shows on dark grounds.
orange-trefoil-flower.title: Small orange trefoil flower

right-black-leaf-curl-on-blue-and-gold-s.description: A painted stem of pink, blue and gold stripes runs diagonally from the lower left and ends in a blue and pink angular node, from which a thin black ink line climbs upward with small solid leaf blobs, loops once halfway up and ends in a hooked tip at the top. Black contours; the background is transparent.
right-black-leaf-curl-on-blue-and-gold-s.quality: The painted stem is cut flat at the left edge where it left the bar border.
right-black-leaf-curl-on-blue-and-gold-s.title: Black leaf scroll rising from a painted stem
usage_notes: Right end of the fol. 52r bottom bar; the flourish climbs the right edge of a block.

right-pointed-blue-and-gold-leaf-swash.description: A blue foliate swash rising from the lower left to the upper right, shaped like an angular leaf with a spiky pointed lobe at its right end. A gold stroke runs along its length, white lines and small white marks pick out the inner edges, and a thin black contour surrounds it. The left end is cut flat where it joined the decorated letter; the background is transparent.
right-pointed-blue-and-gold-leaf-swash.quality: Cut flat at the left edge where it left the decorated letter.
right-pointed-blue-and-gold-leaf-swash.title: Pointed blue and gold leaf swash

seated-harp-player.description: A man in a gold tunic and a white cap sits in profile facing right on a blue box-like bench and plays a tall triangular harp with an orange-red frame and white strings, one hand raised to the top of the frame, the other plucking the strings. Brown hose, one foot hanging below the seat, black contours; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Man playing harp and dog dancing

seated-harp-player.title: Seated harper in a gold tunic
usage_notes: Pairs with dancing-dog, which dances to this harp; set the dog at the right so the two face each other.

short-blue-and-gold-curled-leaf-terminal.description: A short horizontal segment of bar border running to the right and curling down at its right end. It is built of parallel stripes of gold, brown, blue and white inside a black contour, the gold leaf flaking in places; the left end is cut flat where it left the bar, showing blue and white. The background is transparent.
short-blue-and-gold-curled-leaf-terminal.quality: Cut flat at the left edge where it left the bar border.
short-blue-and-gold-curled-leaf-terminal.title: Short striped bar end curling down
usage_notes: Right-hand end piece for a horizontal rule; butt its cut left edge against a bar of similar thickness.

two-dancing-monkeys.description: Two cream monkeys dance leaning away from each other, joined by their clasped inner hands at the centre, each raising the outer arm with a closed fist. The left monkey has hatched fur and faces right; the right one is smooth and faces left; both stand on bent legs with splayed feet. Black contours with light tan shading; the background is transparent.
two-dancing-monkeys.title: Two monkeys dancing hand in hand

upper-margin-with-three-grotesque-heads.description: A long horizontal bar from the top margin. At the left it ends in a blue angular foliate knot with orange-tipped lobes and a gold disc; the bar runs right as a blue band with a white line, a pink band with white dots and a thin gold rule, then thins into a plain rod. On the right half a blue four-legged hybrid with a human head crawls to the right, a small bald grotesque head sits on the rod, and the bar ends in a larger head in a white hood. Black contours; the background is transparent.
upper-margin-with-three-grotesque-heads.title: Top-margin bar with a crawling hybrid and three heads
usage_notes: Top side of the fol. 52r bar border; sits above a block with left-rod-with-two-profile-heads down its left edge.

woman-leading-harrow-horse.description: A woman in an orange-red robe and white wimple walks at the right, facing left, and raises a long green switch over a cream horse that walks left in front of her. The horse wears a dark collar and harness lines that run back to a green triangular harrow with dark teeth, dragged along the ground at the far left by a short shaft. Black contours; the background is transparent.
woman-leading-harrow-horse.title: Woman driving a horse that drags a harrow
usage_notes: The harrow is a solid green panel with dark teeth; the thin harness lines between horse and harrow are intentionally kept, so crop around the whole group.

summary: Monkeys singing, dancing and playing chess, a harpist with a dancing dog and a woman leading a harrow horse, from the margins of Walters Ms. W.88, a Book of Hours of the first quarter of the 14th century, grouped by folio.
title: Walters W.88, Book of Hours monkeys and musicians
